title: Attendance Policy
content: SRMist enforces a strict attendance policy. Students are expected to maintain 100% attendance in all classes. However, a minimum of 75% attendance in each course (both theory and practical classes separately) is mandatory to be eligible to appear for the End Semester Examinations. A condonation of up to 10% (between 65% and 74%) may be granted by the Head of the Institution on genuine medical grounds or for representing the university in official co-curricular/extracurricular activities, supported by valid medical certificates or duty certificates. Students whose attendance falls below 65% are strictly not permitted to write the end semester exams and will receive a 'W' (Withheld due to lack of attendance) grade, requiring them to register and repeat the course in a subsequent semester or during summer term.
